Title: Marsh Lock Footbridge closure
Description: Thames Path closed at Marsh Lock south of Henley-on-Thames. Diversion via A4155 approximately 3 miles. Environment Agency closed for safety grounds.
Status: Active - closure order until 31 Jan 2026, likely extended

Title: Temple Footbridge closed
Description: Temple Footbridge permanently closed due to structural issues. Diversion via Marlow Bridge and Bisham Abbey to Marlow. Note: Marlow Bridge closed weekends 14/15 March, 11/12 April, 18/19 April.

Title: Sandford Footbridge closure
Description: Footbridge north of Sandford Lock closed for safety. Diversion via NCN 5 cycle route.
Status: Active - closed due to structural issues

Title: Abingdon Weir walkway closure
Description: Walkway across Abingdon Weir closed due to corrosion. Path rerouted via Abingdon town centre. Reopens at low river levels, closes when levels rise.

Title: Osney Bridge diversion
Description: Towpath closed about 150 yards from Osney Bridge. Diversion via Abbey Road and Botley Road to rejoin at bridge.

Title: Bell Weir Lock site works diversion
Description: Small diversion at Runnymede Pleasure Grounds around compound with standing machinery for Bell Weir refurbishment works. Spring 2026 to autumn 2027.

Title: Runnymede Bridge 142 footbridge closure
Description: Footbridge south of Runnymede Bridge/M25 closed for public safety due to structural damage from flooding. Diversion via A308 and Causeway. Expected closure early 2024 to at least 2026.

Title: Penton Hook Island closure
Description: Penton Hook Island closed to public due to diseased ash trees posing safety risk. Tree clearance work planned after bird nesting season (after September). Thames Path unaffected.

Title: Ten Foot Bridge closure
Description: Ten Foot Bridge between Rushey and Shifford locks near Buckland village in Faringdon closed March 2024 due to structural and safety concerns. No reopening date confirmed.

Title: Streatley-Goring towpath diversion
Description: Weir damaged in 2022 and being repaired. Diversion via minor roads through Preston Crowmarsh and Howbery Business Park, crossing at Wallingford Bridge. Shuttle ferry service available weekends 10am-4pm.
Status: Active - diversion in place, ferry service limited

Title: Brentford Grand Union Canal disruption
Description: Path blocked on left bank of Grand Union Canal between bridge over River Brent and Brentford Marina. Parts now open - possible to walk The Ham, cross canal, follow canal to Thames Lock, cross back at Lock and follow Dock Road.
